Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football | National Black Stars to get substantive coach by November – GFA Source : Princeton Wiredu 20 October 2026 8:53am Henry Asante Twum Audio By Carbonatix
The Black Stars is set to get a substantive coach by November 2026, following Carlos Queiroz’s departure, according to the Ghana Football Association (GFA) Communications Director, Henry Asante Twum.
Kim Lars Björkegren, who is in charge of the Black Queens, has been handed the men’s senior national team role on a temporary basis for the upcoming Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers against Somalia in November.
A five-member committee recommended Björkegren for the position, with Ibrahim Tanko and Godwin Attram serving as his assistants.
Speaking to Luv FM, Henry said: “they [committee] want to get us a coach by November. In terms of actuals I don’t have but I know by the end of the two games against Somalia, they will be in a position to tells who is our coach."
However, Henry mentioned that the objective of the team is to get back on track in the AFCON qualifiers.
“The two games ahead of us are very important that any other subject. We need to get back on track and must get results in the next matches” - he said.
